main.description: A real, permanent receipt of a blubberize.bisks.net fission: written to the acting user's own repo the moment they hit FISSION while signed in. Purely a signed record of the bit — it has no effect on the target's actual ability to post anywhere. Read by blubberize (https://blubberize.bisks.net) via Jetstream + com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection to build the site's live, network-wide fission log.

target.description: DID of the account fissioned at.

targetHandle.description: Handle of the target at the moment of fission.

blubber.description: Follower-equivalent blubber transferred — half the fissioner's real followersCount at the time.

yourFollowers.description: The fissioner's real followersCount at the time of fission.

createdAt.description: When the fission happened, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
